meta.title: Makeborne funnel and ARR calculator inputs
meta.window: 2026-10-28 to 2027-01-26 (13 weeks, 91 model days; day 1 = Wed 28 Oct 2026, the public launch; the day-90 review is Mon 25 Jan 2027)

labels.A: assumption to replace with week 1-2 data

meta.howToUse: Load defaults, let the visitor pick low / base / high for each input (or type a value), run the daily model described in formulas, and show MRR, ARR, active subscribers, paid CAC and the weekly table. referenceOutputs in each scenario let the website check its implementation (match within ~1%).
meta.liveOnly: The model promotes nothing. Inputs that depend on features that are not live are tagged beat:<feature> and must stay off until that beat passes the gate.
consistencyNotes: 1. At the research desk's own inputs (creator CPM $5, 0.6% view-to-visit, 1.0% visit-to-paid) a paid creator payer costs about $98, double the $50 gate, and Content Rewards at 0.24% click costs about $78. The plan's base (~46k visits including loops, ~$174k ARR) therefore only holds if creator traffic converts ~1.5x the blended rate or clicks at 0.8%+. The baseStrict scenario shows the downside. Check this at the 30 Nov paid-CAC check with real /go/ data (16 Nov is too early to read the creator test).

2. The plan's 50,000 base visits include ~6,000 loop visits. Here loops are modelled as payers (viralCoefficient), so qualifiedVisits in referenceOutputs is lower than 50,000; add loopVisitsImplied for a like-for-like total.
3. Yearly subscribers are not churned inside the window (the plan's model churned everyone), which lifts end MRR slightly for the same gross payers.

4. The calculator base reproduces the plan's 13-week totals (about 500 gross payers, about 390 active, about $14.5k MRR) but not its weekly table: launch week here is about 24 gross payers on about 2,350 organic visits against the plan's 35 on 3,500, because the plan's weekly visits already include paid and loop traffic. data/kpis.json weeklyTargets keep the plan-of-record table.
5. The weekly shape and channel split are estimates. Replace visitsPerDay with measured /go/ and counter data from week 2 (re-forecast rule, strategy.md 13).

6. plan.json scenarios and the strategy.md 14.2 table were regenerated from this calculator on 26 Oct 2026 (python data/funnel_model.py), so the site shows one set of numbers. The earlier hand model was higher for high and breakout: high MRR day 30 / day 60 $14.7k / $29.8k (calculator $8.9k / $23.2k) and breakout $15.4k / $45.1k (calculator $8.6k / $31.7k), because the calculator back-loads paid traffic behind the D4 reinvestment caps. Visits including loop-implied visits are about 94k for high (hand model 110k) and about 117k for breakout (hand model 150k). Under D4 (30% of weekly net cash, at most 1.5x growth a week, $150 floor, $2,000 weekly cap) breakout reinvests about $1,978 by the end of week 8 (about $989 into Content Rewards) and about $10.8k over 13 weeks (about $5.4k into Content Rewards); base about $1.8k and high about $4.6k into Content Rewards. Loops reach about 12% of breakout payers in week 8 (16% at most). scripts/check-routes.mjs fails if a plan.json scenario's mrrDay90 drifts more than 5% from its referenceOutputs.mrrEnd.

formulas.words: Organic visits for the window = sum of visitsPerDay over all channels x horizonDays. Organic visits on a day = that total x weeklyShape[week] / 7.
Visit-to-paid = signupRate x paidRate, where paidRate = checkoutOpenRate x checkoutToPaidRate. If the preview option is on from its start week, multiply by preview.paidRateUplift.

Each budget line with a bucket (creators, boosts, contentRewards) is spread evenly across the days of its listed weeks. Lines marked conditional (the b9 reserve) are only spent in a week where the reinvestment rule allows spending (CAC test passed).
Cost per paid visit: creators = creatorCPM / (1000 x creatorClickRate); boosts = adCPC; Content Rewards = contentRewardsCPM / (1000 x contentRewardsClickRate).
Paid visits on a day = spend in each bucket that day / that bucket's cost per visit, summed over buckets.

Gross payers from loops on a day = viralCoefficient / 30 x active subscribers at the end of the previous day. Loop traffic is not added to visits; loopVisitsImplied = loop gross payers / visit-to-paid, for display only.
Gross new payers on a day = organic visits x visit-to-paid + sum over paid buckets of (paid visits x visit-to-paid x paidConversionMultiplier[bucket]) + loop payers.
Net new payers = gross x (1 - refundRate). Refunds are taken on the day of purchase (they happen within 14 days).
Net payers split into yearly (x yearlyShare) and monthly (x (1 - yearlyShare)). Yearly subscribers stay active for the whole window.
Each day's monthly cohort survives at each 30-day renewal: active = cohort x (1 - monthlyChurn) ^ floor(age in days / 30).
Blended monthly list price = sum over plans of planMix x monthly price (Create $20, Studio $49, Scale $99).
MRR = active monthly subscribers x blended price + active yearly subscribers x blended price x (1 - yearlyDiscount). ARR = MRR x 12. Net ARPU = blended price x (1 - yearlyShare x yearlyDiscount).

Net new cash on a day = (new monthly net payers x blended price + new yearly net payers x blended price x 12 x (1 - yearlyDiscount)) x (1 - feePct) - net payers x feeFixed - preview AI cost. Renewals are excluded (the D4 rule reinvests net NEW cash).
Paid CAC = cumulative paid spend / cumulative net payers from paid buckets (paid visits x visit-to-paid x multiplier x (1 - refundRate)).

Every Monday from week 3: if cumulative paid net payers >= 3 and paid CAC <= $50, reinvest 30% of last week's net new cash; if CAC is within 25% above $50, reinvest 10%; otherwise 0. Cap the week at min(maxWeeklyUsd, max(growthFloorUsd, last week's reinvestment x maxWeeklyGrowth)). Send contentRewardsShare (50%) to Content Rewards once MRR >= $1,500, the rest to creator rehires.
Activated payers (north star) = net payers x activationRate (60% in weeks 1-4, 70% after).
AI daily limit needed on the peak day = peak gross payers per day x firstBuildsPerPayerDay1 x first site build cost (median $0.93, worst $1.35).
Monthly contribution at the end = active subscribers x sum over plans of planMix x contributionPerSubMonth. Excludes tax, hosting, email, support, disputes and payout fees.
If the preview is on: preview AI cost per day = (visits x signupRate) x preview.takeRate x preview.costUsd, subtracted from net new cash.
